title: Sourdough for beginners
summary: Mix, fold and bake one loaf, and take a jar of starter home. No experience needed.

title: Fix your own bike
summary: Learn to fix a puncture, adjust brakes and gears, and oil a chain. Bring your own bike.

title: Lino printing
summary: Carve a simple design and print a small run of cards on the studio press.

title: Soil, seeds and small spaces
summary: Plan a productive balcony or windowsill and start your first seeds.

title: Repair cafe skills: sewing
summary: Darn, patch and re-hem. Bring one item that needs mending.

title: Pen and ink drawing
summary: Build up texture and shade with a dip pen. Materials are provided.
